title: 第八百八十九章 天圣城VS乱星域第八百八十八章 真难杀呀
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始
content_zh:
“天圣城攻来了！”
“敌人来了！”
……
三大王城与三座大山，如今连成的结界内。
无数武者惊呼议论，攀上山峰远眺四方。
他们率先看到的，是滚滚黑气如浪潮般蔓延而来。
离得近了，众人才看到，浓密黑雾中，前方竟是数量庞大，密密麻麻宛如蝗虫一般的生物。
“是星兽！”
此时斩岳城城楼，三王八将，以及顾尘风聚在一处，同样向下远眺。
虽然前方派出的哨探，早已带回前线消息。
但当他们看到魔潮之中，涌现出数量庞大的星兽，众人还是有些吃惊。
“天圣城这些家伙，果然早有准备。”殷红鸾语气严肃。
其他人的脸色也都是有些凝重。
对此，与噬魂兽交战已久的顾尘风，倒是习以为常。
四族噬魂兽最大的天赋，就是附身，通过快速的繁殖与附身，侵占其他生灵的躯壳。
这种特点使得他们可以快速入侵，并摧毁一座文明。
在数量庞大的星兽后方，还有大量被附身的人妖两族，以及其他异族武者。
他们数量同样惊人，且其中蕴藏着许多气息非凡，实力强横之辈，天圣城的底蕴可见一斑。
随着敌军出现在三大王城外围，众人的视野之中。
没有多余的对峙和等待。

“轰隆隆！”
大地逐渐传来震动之声。
“吼吼……！”
星兽的咆哮和嘶吼之声，由远及近的传来，远方大地烟尘和魔气翻涌，天圣城方面竟直接发动了冲锋。
浩瀚的星兽大军，在冲锋过程中，迅速汇聚成三路，浩浩荡荡地朝三大王城冲击而来。
见此情形，城楼上的三王面色凝重，却毫无惧色。
殷红鸾大手一挥，发号施令。
“咚咚咚……！”
下一刻，三大王城之上，擂鼓之声宛若雷霆轰鸣。
三座大山脚下，三座结界之门大开。
以三大王城为首，乱星域各族武者集结成的联军，汹涌出结界。
近万年的发展，加上乱星域强者为尊，适者生存的法则，同样孕育出大量英勇善战的强者。
天圣城的进攻，固然曾让他们感受到恐惧。
但有三大王城结盟，站在前方振臂高呼，也让他们看到了希望。
生存的本能驱使下，令他们再无惧与天圣城正面一战。
content_en:
"The Holy City is coming!"
"The enemy is coming!"
…
Three major royal cities and three major mountains are now connected within a barrier.
Countless warriors were exclaiming and talking, climbing up the mountain to look out in all directions.
The first thing they saw was the billowing black air spreading like a wave.
When they got closer, everyone saw that in the thick black mist, there were a huge number of creatures in front of them, densely packed like locusts.
"It's a star beast!"
At this time, the three kings and eight generals, as well as Gu Chenfeng gathered at the tower of Zhanyue City, also looking down into the distance.
Although the sentinels sent from the front have already brought back news from the front line.
But when they saw a huge number of star beasts emerging from the demonic tide, everyone was still a little surprised.
"These guys from Tiansheng City are indeed well prepared." Yin Hongluan said in a serious tone.
The faces of the others were also a little solemn.
Gu Chenfeng, who had been fighting soul-eating beasts for a long time, was used to this.
The greatest talent of the four tribes of soul-eating beasts is possession. Through rapid reproduction and possession, they can invade the bodies of other living beings.
This characteristic allows them to quickly invade and destroy a civilization.
Behind the huge number of star beasts, there are also a large number of possessed humans and demons, as well as other alien warriors.
Their number is equally astonishing, and they contain many people with extraordinary auras and powerful strength. The foundation of Tiansheng City is evident.
As the enemy troops appeared on the outskirts of the three royal cities, they were in everyone's sight.
There is no unnecessary confrontation and waiting.
"Boom!"
The earth gradually began to vibrate.
"Ho ho ho...!"
The roars and roars of the star beasts came from far and near. Smoke, dust and demonic energy surged in the distance, and Tiansheng City actually launched a direct charge.
During the charge, the vast army of star beasts quickly gathered into three groups and charged towards the three royal cities in a mighty manner.
Seeing this situation, the three kings on the tower looked solemn, but showed no fear.
Yin Hongluan waved his big hand and gave orders.
"Dong dong dong...!"
The next moment, above the three royal cities, the sound of beating drums was like the roar of thunder.
At the foot of the three mountains, the three barrier gates were wide open.
Led by the three major royal cities, a coalition of warriors from all races in the Chaotic Star Region surged out of the barrier.
Nearly ten thousand years of development, coupled with the law of survival of the fittest and the rule of survival of the fittest in the Chaos Star Territory, have also given birth to a large number of brave and capable warriors.
The attack of Tiansheng City certainly made them feel fear.
However, the three major royal cities formed an alliance and stood in front of them, raising their arms and shouting, which gave them hope.
Driven by the instinct of survival, they no longer fear a head-on battle with Tiansheng City.
